requests.reply:
In the early morning, the mist still lingered outside the temple gates.
Cloud Boat, you've finally returned. Did you bring back the Ling Stone?
I brought three bags, all from the best part of the mountain.
The barrier has cracked again last night, and Elder Qin didn't sleep at all.

Before he could finish speaking, Wan Yi Jing rushed up from below the mountain.
He gasped, "I saw a young woman lying on the side of the road near the foot of the mountain."
Quickly, lift her up. Go get the medicinal herbs.
Wan Si Jing, carrying the unconscious woman, rushed into the main hall. The iron badge on his belt read: "Qiu Shuang."
The injury isn't serious; it's just that the spiritual energy has been depleted. Give her a pill to restore her energy.

Sister Zeng, Elder Qin asked you to go to the barrier area; I and Brother Wan Si are here.
Okay. When Miss Chou wakes up, please come and get me immediately.
Wansita Jing scratched his head and then turned to run towards the foot of the mountain.
Li Xuan stood at the entrance to the hall, his sword still sheathed, but the lights flickered for a moment.
Elder Qin, how have you been? I have come at the order of the Master, to collect one-third of the spirit stones.

Three-fifths of the spirit stones? Those were painstakingly accumulated by the sect. When would it be someone else's turn to take them?

The barrier has already been breached, and the spirit stones are no longer safe in your possession. I will return in three days.
解玄 let out a cold laugh and turned to leave, not even bothering to look back.
If he says it will take three days, it will definitely take three days. He never breaks his promises.
Elder Qin stroked his beard and looked at the sleeping Ms. Chou on the mat.

Elder, please go and guard the barrier. Miss Chou has Mr. Lu to take care of her, so I can leave.
Finally, he nodded and took out a jade token from his sleeve.
This is the key to the formation. By protecting it, you are protecting your own path.
乐川 placed the medicine pouch inside the cloud boat, and then quietly reminded him of a few things.

At the entrance of the mountain, Wan Si Jing handed over a蓑衣 (蓑衣 -蓑衣).
"Thank you, Senior Wan Si. Miss Chou is awake, please thank her for me."
Dan Yunzhou nodded, carefully tucking away the order to focus the formation.
Inside the hall, Ms. Chou slowly opened her eyes.
It's alright, you've just been sleeping. Don't move around too much.

Chu Shuang struggled to sit up, looking out at the torn curtain of sky.
Unnoticed, a note in her sleeve bore the seal of He Xuan.
